name: Casablanca Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces
keyfacts: Casablanca Valley is in the Valparaíso region.
It is known for white wines, notably Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay, and for Pinot Noir, which suits its cool climate.
Pacific maritime influence and morning fog cool the valley's climate.

notes: Casablanca is a cool, ocean-influenced valley whose leading grapes are Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay.

blurb.text: A subregion of Chile's Aconcagua wine region, which covers all the vineyards of the Valparaíso Region.
